# Rigged rural NPC source

Source: https://grab3d.com/models/characters/man-base-character/
License: CC0-1.0; retained in LICENSE.txt.
Origin: AI-assisted base mesh/textures (Meshy), cleaned and rigged by Grab3D, according to the publisher.
Downloaded FBX and GLB into this project only. Textures were extracted from the GLB.

Unity uses the FBX as a Humanoid, the supplied in-place walk animation, a URP material, and procedural two-bone work poses on the imported skeleton. Farming tools and a conical hat are project-made attachments. The original source files remain unmodified.
